title: Compress Extension
description: Compression metadata for Earth observation and environmental data.

id.description: Unique identifier for this encoded component.

role.description: Whether the component carries the base approximation or transform details.

asset.description: Key of the STAC Item asset containing this component.

reconstruction_order.description: Order in which this component is consumed by the reconstruction procedure.

level.description: Transform decomposition level for this component.

subbands.description: Transform subbands carried by this component.

mode.description: Fidelity mode used to encode this component.

compressed_bytes.description: Encoded size of this component in bytes.

target_bits_per_value.description: Target encoded rate for this component in bits per coefficient.

quantization_step.description: Quantization step applied to this component's transform coefficients.

error_bound.description: Error bound for this component, in the units given by error_bound_unit.

error_bound_unit.description: Unit of this component's error bound, such as a transform-coefficient unit.

compress:mode.description: Fidelity mode of the compressed representation.

compress:codec_version.description: Version of the codec or algorithm.

compress:configuration.description: Name or identifier of the complete codec configuration.

compress:objective.description: Trade-off prioritized by the compression configuration.

compress:parameters.description: Codec-specific options used to produce the compressed representation.

compress:components.description: Encoded components, their STAC assets, and the order and settings needed to combine them.

operation.description: Operation used to reconstruct the decoded values from transform components.

transform.description: Transform used to create the components.

wavelet.description: Wavelet family and variant, if the transform is a wavelet transform.

axes.description: Zero-based array axes transformed, in transform order.

boundary_extension.description: Boundary rule used by the forward and inverse transforms.

output_dtype.description: Data type of the reconstructed array.

output_conversion.description: Rounding, clipping, or casting applied after inverse transformation.

omitted_component_policy.description: How reconstruction handles a component that is not fetched or decoded.

compress:reconstruction.description: Transform and reconstruction instructions for combining the components.

compress:error_bound.description: Maximum absolute error in near-lossless mode or maximum RMSE in lossy mode.

compress:error_bound_unit.description: Native unit of the error bound.

compress:nodata_preserved.description: Whether NoData positions are preserved and no new NoData values are introduced.

compress:zero_preserved.description: Whether exact zeros in native units are preserved.

compress:input_bytes.description: Size of the uncompressed input representation in bytes.

compress:compressed_bytes.description: Size of the compressed representation in bytes.

compress:compression_ratio.description: Input size divided by compressed size.

compress:bits_per_value.description: Compressed size in bits per input value.

compress:encode_time_seconds.description: Time to encode the representation in seconds.

compress:decode_time_seconds.description: Time to decode the representation in seconds.

compress:encode_throughput_mb_s.description: Encoding throughput in decimal megabytes per second.

compress:decode_throughput_mb_s.description: Decoding throughput in decimal megabytes per second.

compress:downstream_metrics.description: Named downstream task metrics measured on the compressed representation.
